title: CUISINE
lede: A quick way into Cambodia’s food culture — what to order, when to eat it, and the dishes worth planning a day around.

chapters.description: Cool rice noodles, green fish curry and a fistful of herbs — Cambodia’s most quietly perfect breakfast.
Freshwater fish steamed with coconut custard and kroeung. Subtle, aromatic, and much better than its tourist-menu reputation.
Peppery seared beef, crisp vegetables and a sharp lime dip: the easy crowd-pleaser after a temple-heavy day.

paretoPick.label: PARETO PICK
paretoPick.copy: Spend less time chasing restaurant lists: one market breakfast, one home-style lunch, one good Kampot-pepper dinner.
